MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The caliper fits my interest in assembling small electronics because measuring components would help me check whether parts fit together.",
    "Sugru feels useful for securing awkward parts and making small repairs, which connects with my previous use of reclosable fasteners.",
    "Silica packets could help protect stored electronic components, though I would wait until I actually needed moisture protection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs and pull-chain switch are electrical parts, but their specific uses do not match the small breadboard, PCB, and relay projects in my history.",
    "Printer filament assumes I own and use a 3D printer, which my electronics purchases do not establish.",
    "The gloves, vials, drywall anchors, and food-service scoop lack a clear use in my current projects; the thousand-glove quantity and uncertain small size make the gloves especially unsuitable."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electrical components seems to have been stretched to include electrical supplies regardless of their size or purpose.",
    "My practical DIY purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply, even when it requires a separate project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, PCB supplies, jumper wires, and relay point toward small component assembly, where dimensions and compatibility matter.",
    "I need a concrete use before choosing a specialized part or bulk supply; being potentially useful someday is usually insufficient.",
    "A broadly useful measuring or repair tool feels more relevant than a replacement part that requires a particular device or repair need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my practical electronics and DIY interests but often miss the project scale and immediate usefulness that determine what I would choose."
}
